scene.ko: 제품 출시 직전에 휴가를 신청하며 팀장의 걱정을 듣고, 업무 인수인계 계획과 절충안을 제시한다.

lines.en: Hi, Jennifer. Do you have a few minutes? I wanted to ask about taking some time off next month.
lines.ko: 제니퍼 팀장님, 잠깐 시간 괜찮으세요? 다음 달에 휴가를 내는 것 때문에 여쭤보고 싶어서요.
alt: Hi, Jennifer. Have you got a minute? I'd like to talk about taking a few days off next month.

lines.en: Sure. What dates are you thinking of?
I'd like to take the 14th through the 22nd off. My sister is getting married in Canada.
alt: I'm thinking of the 14th to the 22nd. My sister's wedding is in Canada.

lines.en: Oh, congratulations! The only thing is, that's right before the product launch on the 25th. I'm a little worried about the timing.
lines.ko: 어머, 축하해요! 다만 25일 제품 출시 바로 전이라서요. 시기가 좀 걱정되네요.

lines.en: I completely understand. I've thought about that, and I plan to finish the user guide and the training slides before I leave.
lines.ko: 충분히 이해합니다. 저도 그 부분을 생각해 봤는데, 떠나기 전에 사용자 설명서랑 교육 자료는 끝내 놓을 계획이에요.
alt: I understand. I've already thought about it, and I'll have the user guide and training slides done before I go.

lines.en: That helps. But who would handle customer questions while you're away?
lines.ko: 그건 도움이 되네요. 그런데 자리 비운 동안 고객 문의는 누가 처리하죠?

lines.en: I've already talked to Hana, and she's agreed to cover for me. I'll walk her through everything next week.
lines.ko: 이미 하나 씨와 이야기했는데, 제 일을 대신 맡아 주기로 했어요. 다음 주에 하나 씨에게 전부 차근차근 알려 줄 거예요.
alt: Hana said she can cover for me. I'll go over everything with her next week.

lines.en: You've really thought this through. Would you be able to come back a day early, on the 22nd, just to be safe?
lines.ko: 정말 꼼꼼하게 준비했네요. 혹시 모르니 하루 일찍, 22일에 돌아올 수 있을까요?

lines.en: My flight gets in late on the 21st, so coming into the office the next morning would be tough. But I could work from home on the 22nd instead. Would that work for you?
lines.ko: 21일 밤늦게 비행기가 도착해서, 다음 날 아침에 출근하기는 좀 힘들 것 같아요. 대신 22일에 재택근무를 할 수는 있는데, 괜찮으실까요?
alt: My flight arrives late on the 21st, so coming in on the 22nd would be hard. How about if I worked from home that day instead?

lines.en: That's a fair compromise. Go ahead and submit the request in the system, and I'll approve it today.
lines.ko: 합리적인 절충안이네요. 시스템에 휴가 신청 올려 줘요. 오늘 승인할게요.

expressions.note: 하루 휴가는 take a day off
상대의 걱정을 먼저 받아 줄 때
휴가 · 병가 때 업무를 맡길 때

expressions.en: I could ___ instead. Would that work for you?
expressions.note: 요청을 다 들어주기 어려울 때 대안을 낼 때
